summary: Phase-by-phase upgrade blueprint for LineBook Pro before commercial launch to micro-lenders. Covers confirmed priorities: (1) Tailwind v4 theme contrast fix and mobile/desktop UI polish, (2) 7-day weekly plus daily and monthly loan schedules alongside guarantor CRM details, 1-tap calling, loan renewal/top-up, and early closure, (3) Daily Cashbook with closing cash in bag, PDF/WhatsApp Borrower Passbook, and CSV exports, (4) Optional Google Sign-In paired with hardened UID-scoped Firebase Firestore cloud sync and cross-phone recovery, and (5) Final SaaS polish with step-by-step verification gates after every phase.
